# Directive Preservation Checklist: Fix //go:embed Directive Preservation

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, and coverage of requirements for compiler directive preservation during declaration reordering
**Created**: 2026-02-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all Go compiler directive types that bind to declarations enumerated in requirements? FR-002 says "all Go compiler directives matching `//go:` prefix" but does not list which specific directives are declaration-bound vs file-level [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements specified for directives on const declarations, not just vars? FR-001 only mentions var; FR-002 is generic but acceptance scenarios only cover var and func [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements specified for directives on type declarations? The spec covers var and func but not type (e.g., `//go:generate` above a type) [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the `_ "embed"` import preservation addressed? `//go:embed` requires the embed import — are requirements defined for ensuring this import is not dropped during reordering? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for what happens to non-directive comments (regular doc comments) that appear alongside directives on the same declaration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is "semantically bound" in FR-001 precisely defined? Does it mean "immediately preceding with no blank lines" or "in the same GenDecl decoration"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "attached to their associated declarations" in FR-002 unambiguous? The mechanism of attachment (AST decoration vs positional proximity) affects correctness criteria [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "relative ordering" in FR-003 specific enough? Does it mean directive-then-declaration, or does it also constrain ordering among multiple directives on the same declaration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the scope of "//go: prefix" matching defined precisely? Should `//go:build` (file-level, not declaration-bound) be explicitly excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 - Is the expected behavior for multiple `//go:embed` directives on one var specified as a concrete acceptance scenario, not just a requirement statement? FR-004 says "handle" but no Given/When/Then [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the expected behavior for `//go:embed` inside grouped `var()` blocks defined as a concrete scenario? FR-005 says "handle" but doesn't specify whether the tool should extract, preserve in-group, or error [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are the four edge case questions in the Edge Cases section resolved with expected behaviors, or are they still open questions? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the expected behavior defined for a directive on the first var in a multi-var `var()` block where other vars have no directives? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is behavior specified for a file that has ONLY directive-bearing vars and no regular vars? (i.e., the merged var block would be empty) [Coverage, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Are the P2 acceptance scenarios (User Story 2) consistent with FR-002's scope? FR-002 covers "all Go compiler directives" but scenarios only test `//go:generate` and `//go:noinline` on functions [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 vs §US-2]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is FR-005 (grouped var blocks) consistent with Go spec constraints? The Go spec says `//go:embed` must precede a standalone `var` declaration, not a spec within `var()` — is FR-005 specifying behavior for invalid input? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do success criteria SC-002 and SC-003 align with the full scope of FR-001 through FR-005? SC items cover basic preservation but not multi-directive or grouped block scenarios [Consistency, Spec §SC vs §FR]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Can SC-002 ("directives remain directly above their vars") be objectively measured without ambiguity about what "directly above" means in the output AST? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-004 ("exact reproduction case from Issue #5") self-contained in the spec, or does it depend on external issue tracker state that may change? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are acceptance scenarios defined for the case where reordering does NOT move a directive-bearing var (no-op preservation)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are recovery/degradation requirements defined for malformed directives (e.g., `//go:embed` with no path argument)? Should the tool preserve them as-is or is this out of scope? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for interaction between directive preservation and the existing config system (strict/warn/append/drop modes)? [Gap, Integration]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the behavior specified when a directive-bearing var would be excluded by a custom section config that omits `exported_vars`? [Gap, Integration]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 - Is the assumption that `dave/dst` preserves directive comments as GenDecl.Decs.Start validated and documented in the spec? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the assumption that function directives are already preserved (plan Change 5) documented as a requirement to verify, not just an assumption? [Assumption]
